messages:
Anna L.: Quick sync — Peregrine (beta) asked for a Private deployment with a private control plane and p99 latency <= 200ms for chat workloads. Customer target is June 14. Need cross-team blockers, owners, and a realistic plan today. @Sophia C. @Jorge M. @Kayla P.
Mike R.: Quick q — is June 14 firm? we have a major release that week.
Anna L.: It's customer-requested but negotiable ±2 weeks if we present a clear plan. They care mainly about latency and data isolation (KMS + VPC + audit logs).
Sophia C.: Runtime note: to hit p99 200ms we should ship quantized weights + KV cache persistence + sticky routing. Rough estimate: 2w eng for optimizations + 1w integration on dedicated infra. Current blocker: cache API doesn't persist across restarts.
Jorge M.: Infra: we can provision a VPC-backed cluster and reserve dedicated GPUs. KMS/HSM integration will add time — vendor onboarding/procurement could be ~3w if serial, ~2w if parallelized. Also need network approvals for cross-account peering.
Kayla P.: Security: need internal review for private control plane, threat model, and KMS attestations. Timeline: 2w for review + 1w for remediation depending on findings. SOC2 artifacts will be required for customer signoff.
Mike R.: From product/SDK side: route-pin API + tenant isolation flags — ~5 dev days + 2 days e2e. Can overlap with runtime work. Also need dedicated QA perf runs.
Anna L.: Okay — rough sequence: (1) vendor/KMS onboarding and network approvals (2) infra + capacity reservation (3) runtime perf work and KV persist (4) API & e2e + canary. Can teams call out owners/risks?
Sophia C.: Owner (runtime): Sophia C. Deliverables: KV persist PR, quantization profile, local perf benchmarks, canary policy. Risk: cache warmup and legacy stateful code paths.
Jorge M.: Owner (infra): Jorge M. Deliverables: VPC design, KMS integration plan, capacity reservation ticket. Risk: procurement delays, firewall rules.
Kayla P.: Owner (security): Kayla P. Deliverables: security checklist, threat model signoff, KMS attestation docs. Risk: missing audit logs or vendor attestations.
Mike R.: Owner (product/SDK): Mike R. Deliverables: route-pin API, e2e tests, migration notes for customer. Risk: API backward compatibility and release window conflicts.
Anna L.: Jorge — can you sketch a short timeline here? I'll assemble a one-pager and share with Peregrine.
Jorge M.: Timeline (high level): week 0: vendor onboarding + KMS start; week 1-2: infra + capacity; week 2-3: runtime optimizations & KV persist; week 3: API changes + e2e; week 4: canary and handoff. Assumes parallel work and no procurement blockage. :calendar: 
Sophia C.: Agree with overlap. I'll flag the cache persistence PR as blocker — https://gh.redwood/repo/pull/512 — please review.
Mike R.: I'll allocate 2 devs to API changes starting week 2 and schedule QA perf runs. @qa-team please confirm availability.
Kayla P.: I'll start the security checklist and post a draft EOD. Any specific compliance asks from Peregrine?
Anna L.: They indicated HIPAA-adjacent controls and required detailed logs; I’ll DM details but assume KMS + VPC + audit logs are gating.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder — prod deploy window 2026-06-12 22:00 UTC overlaps proposed canary week.
Mike R.: Good catch — we should avoid that window. Propose moving canary earlier or slide to week 5.
Anna L.: Action items: Sophia — create runtime PR tracker and list perf targets. Jorge — open infra/capacity ticket. Kayla — start security checklist. Mike — add eng tasks to sprint and schedule QA. Anna — coordinate with customer and produce one-pager tomorrow. :thumbsup: 
Kayla P.: Ack — adding compliance owners and initial checklist.
Sophia C.: Ack — will post benchmark numbers and PR links by Friday.
Jorge M.: Ack — opening infra ticket now: INFRA-2034.
Mike R.: Ack — adding tasks to the sprint board.
Anna L.: Thanks all. If any blocker appears, post here and we'll escalate.
